description: This Java class defines an XML file filter used in a Swing-based file chooser dialog, specifically filtering for files with the '.xml' extension and providing descriptions for ECU definition files.

classes.name: XMLFilter
classes.description: A custom file filter for Swing file chooser dialogs that filters for '.xml' files and provides description handling.

methods.name: XMLFilter
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the filter with default extension 'xml' and description 'ECU Definition Files'.

methods.name: accept
methods.description: Determines if a file or directory should be accepted by the filter; accepts directories and files with registered extensions.

methods.name: getExtension
methods.description: Extracts and returns the lowercase extension of a given file, or null if none is present.

methods.name: addExtension
methods.description: Adds a new extension to the filter's list of accepted extensions.

methods.name: getDescription
methods.description: Returns a string description of the filter, optionally including the list of extensions.

methods.name: setDescription
methods.description: Sets the description string for the filter.

methods.name: setExtensionListInDescription
methods.description: Configures whether the extension list is included in the description output.

methods.name: isExtensionListInDescription
methods.description: Checks whether the extension list is included in the description.
